name: Shenzhen JPT Opto-Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen JPT Opto-Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lasers used for precision testing of integrated circuits and semiconductor optoelectronic devices in China and internationally. It offers intelligent equipment for measurement and microfabrication; and fiber optic devices for optical communication.
